Die Generative KI von Mercury.ai arbeitet ausschließlich auf Basis freigegebener Unternehmensinhalte. Jede Antwort ist auf eine konkrete Wissensquelle zurückführbar und damit nachvollziehbar und rechtssicher. Dynamische Wissensquellen lassen sich in Echtzeit aktivieren oder ausschließen, sodass unterschiedliche Nutzergruppen passgenaue Informationen erhalten. Alle Daten werden ausschließlich in zertifizierten Rechenzentren in Deutschland verarbeitet. Founded in September 2020 by Fabian Heinrich, Moritz Weiermann, Juan Vidal, and Satya Kamal Raparthi, Mercanis offers the AI Procurement Platform, which automates and optimizes the entire source-to-contract (S2C) lifecycle using over 55 autonomous AI agents. The platform is available as a standalone system or as an AI layer integrated into existing procurement landscapes. The Mercanis platform features four key modules: Sourcing (RFx) for automating sourcing events, Supplier Management (SRM) for overseeing supplier activities, Contract Management for handling contracts, and Spend Analytics for providing insights into cost-saving opportunities. The company's target market includes B2B clients in the indirect procurement sector, with notable clients such as Linde, Wilson, and Kellux. Mercanis has raised nearly $30 million in funding and is recognized as one of Europe's leading digital procurement suites.

Lytica primarily serves original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), electronic manufacturing services (EMS), and procurement teams, helping them save costs and build resilient supply chains. With significant funding and a commitment to transparency, Lytica is a vital partner for businesses navigating the complexities of the electronics supply chain.
